item.description: The Flask hook module is completely missing from the codebase. Tests expect Flask-specific request recording capabilities but no implementation exists for handling Flask routes, parameters, and error handlers.
item.contract: Implement a Flask hook module that intercepts and records Flask server-side HTTP requests with proper grouping and labeling. The hook must: 1. Detect Flask application instances and their route definitions 2. Record server-side requests with appropriate group labels matching route decorators (@app.route, @app.errorhandler) 3. Extract and include route parameters in group labels for dynamic routes 4. Properly identify and label error handlers (like @app.errorhandler(404)) 5. Integrate seamlessly with the existing hook system in all.py
